posts.title: About Me
posts.text: 赵子朋，华东师范大学，软件工程研究生，研究方向为图形学物理仿真。主要针对SPH和MPM框架，以及高性能GPU并行方案。本科就读于华东师范大学物理学系。来自徽州，爱画画，爱书法，爱艺术。I am a graduate student in East China Normal University. My primary research interest is Physics-based Simulation. EXPERIENCE Physics Simulation Engineer 物理引擎工程师, 叠纸 PaperGames. 2021-Now EDUCATION M.S. in Computer Graphics, East China Normal University. 2018-2021 B.S. in Physics, East China Normal University. 2014-2018 RESEARCH NEWS!!!
